warning: Curated, not every open-source design project. Code, screenshots, paid examples, model weights and demo assets have separate licenses. Data is observational; do not claim design causality.

sources.title: Attention web designers: You have 50 milliseconds to make a good first impression!
sources.summary: First-glance visual appeal judgments matter; do not confuse them with successful tasks.
sources.limitation: Tests involved particular short exposures and stimuli.

sources.title: The role of visual complexity and prototypicality regarding first impression of websites
sources.summary: Familiar operation and controlled complexity help initial judgments, while brand expression may stay original.
sources.limitation: Not a prescription to copy existing layouts.

sources.title: What is beautiful is usable
sources.summary: Appearance influences perceived usability; test objective task outcomes separately.
sources.limitation: Perception is not task completion.

sources.title: 10 Usability Heuristics for User Interface Design
sources.summary: Status, recognition, undo, consistency and error recovery are essential design review dimensions.
sources.limitation: Expert heuristics cannot replace participant tests.

sources.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.2
sources.summary: Contrast, accessible names, keyboard, focus, reflow and input alternatives are baseline QA.
sources.limitation: Auditing with only automated scanners is insufficient.

sources.title: Pause, Stop, Hide
sources.summary: Give controls for qualifying auto-start moving and auto-updating content.
sources.limitation: Specific exceptions apply; not every transition is prohibited.

sources.title: Animated Transitions in Statistical Data Graphics
sources.summary: State-linked transitions can make data changes easier to follow.
sources.limitation: Data graphics result does not prove arbitrary animations improve conversion.

sources.title: How the Core Web Vitals metrics thresholds were defined
sources.summary: Good p75 LCP ≤2.5s, INP ≤200ms, CLS ≤0.1 are real-user targets.
sources.limitation: A local Lighthouse simulation differs from field data.

sources.title: 5 Steps to Creating a UX-Design Portfolio
sources.summary: Show roles, process, constraints and results, not only polished screens.
sources.limitation: UX hiring research does not predict every engineering hiring decision.

sources.title: Creating a UX Design Portfolio Case Study
sources.summary: Structure case studies as problem, decisions, contribution, evidence and outcome.
sources.limitation: Technical implementation portfolios can adapt this structure.

sources.title: About Us Information on Corporate Websites
sources.summary: Company information should be clear, authentic, transparent and verifiable.
sources.limitation: Testing context varied by corporate type.

sources.title: Product Details Page UX Research
sources.summary: Decision-ready imagery, dimensions, variant clarity, shipping, spec and availability.
sources.limitation: Much of the full benchmark is a paid resource.

sources.title: Checkout UX 2025: 10 Pitfalls and Best Practices
sources.summary: Guest checkout, adaptive errors, shipping clarity and fewer irrelevant form fields.
sources.limitation: Benchmarks do not guarantee conversions for any site.

sources.title: Product Listing Page UX Best Practices
sources.summary: Filter visibility, comparison, scanning and clear sort improve discovery.
sources.limitation: Ecommerce context only.

sources.title: Designing a billing page that converts
sources.summary: Honest totals, currency, errors and clear purchase decisions.
sources.limitation: Company recommendations, not causal experimental proof.

sources.title: Components and patterns
sources.summary: Semantic, accessible controls, errors and feedback with tested examples.
sources.limitation: Government copy/branding should not be cloned.

sources.title: Tab bars
sources.summary: Tabs are for top-level navigation, not actions; keep nested navigation state.
sources.limitation: Don't add a tab for every feature.

sources.title: Onboarding
sources.summary: Start fast, teach by doing, and make onboarding optional when possible.
sources.limitation: Account and permission constraints need individual review.

sources.title: Layouts and navigation patterns
sources.summary: Use familiar navigation bar/rail/drawer by destination count and screen size.
sources.limitation: Android patterns should not be imposed unchanged on iOS.

sources.title: Adaptive app quality guidelines
sources.summary: Support phones, tablets, foldables and resizable windows when in scope.
sources.limitation: Quality tiers depend on device support goals.

sources.title: Core app quality guidelines
sources.summary: Meet stability, expected behavior and honest Play Store listing requirements.
sources.limitation: Snapshot from March; check current policy before submission.

sources.title: Expressive Design: Google's UX Research
sources.summary: Balance emotional expression with familiarity and legibility.
sources.limitation: Do not force a particular Material style onto every brand.

sources.title: Creating Your Product Page
sources.summary: Use real feature screenshots and convincing metadata, with localized assets where available.
sources.limitation: Marketing cannot rescue poor retention and app quality.

sources.title: Product Page Optimization
sources.summary: Run controlled asset tests with sufficient samples instead of assumptions.
sources.limitation: Results from one cohort might not generalize.

sources.title: Store Listing Experiments
sources.summary: Test icons, preview visuals and localized copy one hypothesis at a time.
sources.limitation: Traffic and store tests determine statistical confidence.

sources.title: State of Subscription Apps 2026
sources.summary: Early time-to-value, cancellations, retention and store billing recovery deserve study.
sources.limitation: Observational data from 115k+ apps; correlation is not causation.

sources.title: State of Mobile 2026
sources.summary: Global 2025 IAP estimate of $167bn informs market size, not layouts or individual app income.
sources.limitation: Do not invent named app revenue.

sources.title: 10 Guidelines for Designing Your Site's AI Chatbots
sources.summary: Name bot limitations, context, safe suggestions, task relevance and recoverable errors.
sources.limitation: AI can be entirely unnecessary for a simple page.

sources.title: AI Chat Is Not (Always) the Answer
sources.summary: Test direct search/navigation before adding chat; avoid replacing useful controls.
sources.limitation: Narrow domain assistants may still help.

sources.title: Puter.js Documentation
sources.summary: Frontend access to cloud-model APIs with user-pays authentication; not on-device local inference.
sources.limitation: Requires network, service and user account/allowance.

sources.title: WebLLM Getting Started
sources.summary: WebGPU local inference needs model downloads, progress, memory safeguards and fallback.
sources.limitation: WebGPU and model support differ by browser and device.

sources.title: Transformers.js WebGPU Guide
sources.summary: Embeddings/classification/vision models can run locally with the right browser.
sources.limitation: Library and model weight licenses are different.

sources.title: Get started with built-in AI
sources.summary: Chrome built-in AI feature/browser/device availability must be queried before use.
sources.limitation: Some APIs are desktop-only or in trials.

sources.title: The model-viewer web component
sources.summary: A progressive enhancement path to product 3D/AR viewers.
sources.limitation: Models need optimization, licenses and accessible static fallback.

sources.title: React Three Fiber
sources.summary: React renderer for useful interactive 3D experiences.
sources.limitation: React-version compatibility, device GPU budget and semantics matter.

sources.title: Animation from Interactions
sources.summary: Allow disabling nonessential movement triggered by interactions.
sources.limitation: This is AAA, not an AA mandate.

sources.title: 10 Guidelines for Designing Your Site's AI Chatbots
sources.summary: Context-specific prompts and easy discovery can help, but don't obstruct the page.
sources.limitation: Finding a bot useful is not proven by installing a bubble.
